Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about Black holes

1. The high-resolution spectra and images provided by the HST have been especially well-suited to establishing the prevalence of black holes in the center of nearby galaxies.
2. While it had been hypothesized in the early 1960s that black holes would be found at the centers of some galaxies, and astronomers in the 1980s identified a number of good black hole candidates, work conducted with Hubble shows that black holes are probably common to the centers of all galaxies.
3. The Hubble programs further established that the masses of the nuclear black holes and properties of the galaxies are closely related.
